desc: Derive and code the completion-count function fcount(o, e, want_odd): verify feasibility via exact ceiling/floor slot-count match and return capped factorial product o!*e! or 0.
Handle first position specially (no forced parity): sum fcount over odd/even candidates to get capped total; return [] if total < k.
Implement greedy lexicographic unranking over positions, iterating unused parity-matching candidates in increasing order and subtracting capped block counts from k.
Track used numbers and remaining odd/even counts accurately to avoid off-by-one errors in block subtraction.
Return the constructed permutation or [] when total valid permutations < k (including k out of range).
